patterns.what_worked: Reading the operator's five sentences as four separate mechanisms (row placement, class-agnostic gate, one shared pair height, silent-state visibility) kept the diff small and each change independently pinned. The mutation run found two of this lane's own shortcuts before the operator could: 21/21 mutations killed on a throwaway tree copy, including a latch read and a key read that AceDB's '**' metatable would have turned into SavedVariables writes.
patterns.what_was_hard: AceDB's copyDefaults '**' metatable CREATES a defaults-filled sub-table on any missing-key READ (Libs/AceDB-3.0/AceDB-3.0.lua:88-107). Both new keys (the placement latch and melee_bar_height) therefore had to be rawget-based, and the same hazard turned out to disable the shipped appearance migration (config.lua, out of this lane's scope - filed as F2). The placement rule also had to stay honest about what it cannot read: a dragged or scaled hand row has no derivable vertical offset, so the rule leaves that profile alone rather than guess.
patterns.skill_gap: No in-client access. The rule's behaviour on the operator's own profile, the pair-height feel, the options rendering and the new diag lines are UNVERIFIED (bench report section 8). The two diag-suite cap pins are now expressed as cap arithmetic, which will need the same re-cut if the report grows again.

escalation.recommendation: F2 (appearance migration dead on live profiles) is the one real defect outside this lane's scope: a one-line rawget in config.lua plus a '**'-shaped fixture in tests/appearance_defaults_state.lua.
